home.for.li-6: Diagnose and visualize system bottleneck effortlessly for your next assessment report.
home.why.body: Managing uncertainty via scenario modeling help to make the optimal decision considering the expectation of the unknown future. This helps the decision to be more robust than decision made considering only one future. This also helps to find and quantify the value of flexibility.
home.wwd.p: Advanced decision intelligence based on stochastic optimization and machine learning.
home.wwd.p-3: Data analytics, model building, advanced algorithms and results visualization, all in a unified user friendly interface.
home.tech.head-note: EORC's optimization and machine learning powered decision intelligence handle large-scale energy system models far beyond the limit of industry leading decision solution providers.
home.tech.p-2: Focus on your energy models, EORC's optimization and machine learning will solve the problem with unmatched speed.
technology.tech-hero.page-lede: Advanced optimization and machine learning methods with explicit representations of uncertainty, operating at scale across energy carriers, geographic regions and decision timescales.
technology.step-1.p: EORC's data analytics provides European energy system database with high customization capabilities.
technology.step-2.li: Optimization and machine learning based short-term scenario generation.
technology.step-4.lede: Fast, cost efficient optimization and machine learning based algorithms enabling analysis at high spatial, temporal and technological resolution under multi-timescale uncertainty.
technology.step-5.lede: Interactive visualization and reporting helping you find and demonstrate the hidden value in uncertainty as an expert.
technology.step-5.p: Robust power price forecast based on optimization and machine learning with multi-timescale uncertainty.
technology.meta.description: Optimization and AI methods with explicit representations of uncertainty, for energy system planning and investment decisions at scale.
about.page-hero.page-lede: Edinburgh Operational Research Corporation is a technology company specializing in optimization and decision support under uncertainty for energy systems.
about.about-pillars.p: EORC is a technology company specializing in making decision intelligence under uncertainty for energy systems accessible via optimization and machine learning
about.about-pillars.p-3: We prioritize making advanced modeling and tools accessible and interpretable to asset owners, government agencies, system operators, market analysts from all backgrounds.
about.team.p: Leads EORC and its research. Works on large-scale optimization under uncertainty for energy system planning, and on the algorithms behind the platform.
about.team.p-3: Works on the modeling and solver side of the platform, turning research methods into software that runs at full scale.
about.meta.description: Edinburgh Operational Research Corporation Ltd — optimization and decision support under uncertainty for energy systems.
contact.contact-card-wrap.p: Tell us about your system, decisions and difficulty in modeling uncertainty you are facing, we'll show you how the platform handles them.
